construct.name: cross-scale service resilience under water, energy and compound supply shocks
construct.intended_use: Verify deterministic multi-scale transfer, service-deficit, recovery and conservation metrics over a seven-node basin/district/household reference.
construct.claim_ceiling: Tier 1 deterministic reference only; no regional forecast, stochastic resilience inference, ecological recovery or operational-readiness claim.

units.dependence_statement: Ticks within a trajectory are serially dependent. Shock/policy cells are designed contrasts, not independent empirical samples.

sources.missingness_semantics: The deterministic fixture has complete declared cells; absent cells are missing/unsupported, never zero.

evaluation_distribution.sampling_frame: Three synthetic shock types crossed with four deterministic intervention policies over ten ticks and seven physical inventory nodes.

factors.weight_interpretation: Equal benchmark design coverage, not hazard prevalence.
Equal design coverage, not policy prevalence.

perturbation_families.rationale: A compound water/energy loss tests coupled service deficits without collapsing physical units.
perturbation_families.validity_check: Compare water and energy deficits separately against the isolated-shock controls and verify every ledger conservation residual.
expected_invariants: Water-only shock does not create an energy deficit in the proportional reference fixture.
Energy-only shock does not create a water deficit in the proportional reference fixture.
Every reported regional stock-flow residual remains below 1e-9 in its native unit.
perturbation_families.seed_policy: Deterministic authored fixture; no stochastic seed.

replication_design.independent_unit: One fixed deterministic design matrix; no stochastic or empirical replication is claimed.
replication_design.dependence_assessment: Scenario, strategy, participant and condition cells are deterministic benchmark fixtures, not independent draws from a target population.
replication_design.sample_size_rationale: One deterministic execution is sufficient to verify exact code paths and negative controls; it cannot support confidence intervals or population inference.

baselines.description: Negative-control controller: basin supply cannot reach households without explicit inter-region transfers.
Deterministic proportional deficit allocation across district and household levels.

negative_controls.intervention: Disable all inter-region transfers while keeping basin production available.
negative_controls.expected_result: Households retain service deficits; no service credit is assigned to inaccessible upstream stock.

negative_controls.intervention: Evaluate water-only, energy-only and compound shocks.
negative_controls.expected_result: Water and energy deficit vectors remain separate and isolated shocks do not create cross-unit deficits in the reference fixture.

holdouts.leakage_control: No empirical rows are used; this reference supports no external-generalization claim.

reproduction.configuration_digest: civdyn-cross-scale-resilience-v0.1; 3 shocks; 4 policies; 10 ticks; basin-district-household topology
reproduction.runtime_environment: Rust edition 2024; deterministic benchmark crate; exact-head GitHub Actions workflow
reproduction.humanity_atlas_run_artifact_ref: Not applicable: synthetic benchmark reference execution; no full Humanity Atlas scenario artifact is claimed.

claim_report.claim_ceiling: Tier 1 deterministic reference only; no regional forecast, stochastic resilience inference, ecological recovery or operational-readiness claim.
known_limitations: All physical quantities and node populations are synthetic.
A service-recovery pass is not evidence of ecological recovery or sustainable long-run reserves.
No stochastic, regional-calibrated or predictive inference is performed.
unsupported_strata: Real basins, municipalities, households, demographic cohorts, climate regimes and utility systems.
